description: This file defines classes for a JSON-RPC WebSocket client, service, and service manager, implementing remote procedure calls and service registration over WebSocket connections.

classes.name: JsonRpcClient
classes.description: Handles JSON-RPC communication over WebSocket, managing requests, responses, and incoming messages.

classes.name: Service
classes.description: Represents a remote service with methods that can be registered and invoked via JSON-RPC.

classes.name: ServiceManager
classes.description: Manages multiple services, handles their WebSocket connections, and facilitates registration and communication.

methods.name: open
methods.description: Opens the WebSocket connection for JSON-RPC communication.

methods.name: sendRequest
methods.description: Sends a JSON-RPC request with method name, parameters, and user data.

methods.name: notify
methods.description: Sends a notification message over WebSocket.

methods.name: _onIncomingMessage
methods.description: Handles incoming WebSocket messages and resolves corresponding requests.

methods.name: registerMethod
methods.description: Registers a method with a specific name and version in the service.

methods.name: _callMethodByName
methods.description: Invokes a registered method by name with given parameters.

methods.name: open
methods.description: Initializes the ServiceManager and opens the main JSON-RPC WebSocket connection.

methods.name: registerService
methods.description: Registers a new service and initiates its WebSocket connection.

methods.name: _connectService
methods.description: Establishes a WebSocket connection for a specific service.

methods.name: _controllerActivateService
methods.description: Sends a request to activate a service via JSON-RPC.

methods.name: _sendResponse
methods.description: Sends a JSON-RPC response over WebSocket.

methods.name: _controllerCloneService
methods.description: Clones a service via JSON-RPC request.
